prior_art_found.what: Enhancing Fermentation Process Monitoring through Data-Driven Modeling and Synthetic Time Series Generation (and the related Time-FLM bioreactor foundation model surfaced in the same snippet) — TS foundation-model / deep-learning forecasting for fermentation, but on ethanol/fed-batch bioreactors, not indigo dye vats
prior_art_found.verbatim: Time-FLM adopts a Transformer architecture enhanced with causal attention and a mixture-of-experts stacking mechanism, enabling effective representation of the nonlinear and dynamic behaviors of bioreactors. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that Time-FLM achieves substantial improvements in zero-shot performance over broad-domain on pre-trained time series foundation models and, after full fine-tuning on specific tasks, outperforms most existing deep learning approaches.

prior_art_found.what: MLOps soft sensor for real-time predictions in industrial-scale fed-batch fermentation — uses pH, redox potential, temperature as features for continuous prediction in fermentation, but generic bioprocess, no indigo vat / dye readiness, no zero-shot foundation model

Additionally, electrical capacitance, redox potential, pH, and temperature have been used as features in neural network regression models to create soft sensors for fermentation processes.

prior_art_found.what: Fermentation Blues: Analyzing the Microbiota of Traditional Indigo Vat Dyeing in Hunan, China — confirms indigo vats are monitored via pH/ORP electrodes and judged by color turn, but is microbiota/sensor characterization only, NO forecasting model of readiness

The changes in pH, redox potential, and temperature are monitored during the traditional indigo fermentation process. Traditional indigo dyeing vats require approximately 27 days for fermentation until the dye liquid turns yellow-green in color

prior_art_found.what: Fast prediction of optimal reaction conditions and dyeing effects of natural dyes on silk fabrics by lightweight integrated learning (XGBoost) — ML for natural-dye conditions, but optimization of dyeing outcomes, NOT temporal forecasting of fermentation vat readiness
prior_art_found.verbatim: Recent machine learning research has achieved high prediction accuracies (up to 94% in validation) for natural dye reaction conditions using XGBoost models trained on 350 natural dye experiments, though this focuses on optimization rather than specifically vat readiness.

results.exact_unused_slice: Zero-shot multivariate time-series FORECASTING (via a foundation model like Toto, no per-vat training) of WHEN a natural indigo fermentation vat's sparse per-vat channels (pH/ORP/color) cross a redox/microbial readiness threshold. Existing fermentation foundation-model/soft-sensor work (Time-FLM, MLOps soft sensors) targets industrial bioreactors (ethanol, fed-batch, cell culture); indigo-vat work is sensor/microbiota characterization with NO predictive forecasting; no one couples a zero-shot multivariate TSFM to the data-scarce per-vat indigo-readiness problem.
results.honest_adjacency: Time-FLM (a Transformer bioreactor forecasting foundation model with demonstrated zero-shot performance over broad-domain TSFMs) and MLOps/soft-sensor fermentation forecasters already do exactly the *method* (zero-shot / few-step-ahead forecasting from pH+redox+temperature channels) for fermentation — they are squarely adjacent on technique. Separately, the Hunan indigo-vat microbiota study confirms the *domain* monitors the very same pH/ORP/color channels. The gap is that no work has bridged these two: a data-scarce, per-vat, zero-shot multivariate readiness forecast for indigo natural-dye vats.
results.reasoning: 5 reformulations (technique x app; app+ML; app via traditional craft methods; adjacent industrial soft-sensor forecasting; named TSFMs x bioprocess). The method exists for fermentation broadly and the channels exist for indigo vats, but the specific intersection — Toto-style zero-shot multivariate forecasting of indigo vat readiness under per-vat data scarcity — was not found. Because both the method (fermentation TS forecasting) and the channels (indigo pH/ORP/color sensing) are independently documented and only the exact slice is unmade, this is NARROW rather than OPEN.

results.exact_unused_slice: Using ENERGY-GUIDED FLOW MATCHING (EnFlow-style few-step generative ground-state identification) to predict the GROUND-STATE STRUCTURE / AGGREGATION of a precipitated traditional LAKE-PIGMENT dye-mordant complex (madder/carmine + Al/Ca/Sn) AS A FUNCTION OF RECIPE PARAMETERS (pH, mordant ratio), then mapping that structure to color/transparency/lightfastness. The technique is used for MOF crystals (MOFFlow) and small-molecule conformers (EnFlow); lake-pigment color is predicted by DFT/TD-DFT forward computation from a known structure, not generated from recipe parameters.
results.honest_adjacency: Two flanking bodies of work exist. (1) Structure->color is solved for madder/carmine lakes by quantum chemistry (In-silico Madder color prediction; carmine structure paper; alizarin TD-DFT) — but these need a known/assumed structure and use DFT, not a generative recipe->structure model. (2) Flow-matching/energy-guided generative structure prediction for metal-organic complexes exists (MOFFlow, diffusion/flow MOF models, deep generative transition-metal complex inverse design) — but on MOF crystals/coordination complexes, decoupled from lake-pigment color/lightfastness. EnFlow's exact slice (generative ground-state structure of a dye-mordant precipitate from craft recipe params, tied to perceived color) sits in the unbridged gap between (1) and (2).
results.reasoning: 5 reformulations (technique x app; app+ML/recipe; generative complex-from-synthesis-conditions; DFT/TD-DFT lake color; ML pigment recipe inverse design). The structure->color science for madder/carmine lakes is well developed (DFT) and flow-matching structure prediction for metal-organic complexes exists (MOFFlow), but neither does the EnFlow-style generation of the precipitated dye-mordant ground-state structure from recipe parameters mapped to color. Both halves are independently documented and only the precise intersection is unmade, so NARROW rather than OPEN.

results.exact_unused_slice: AMORTIZED (one-forward-pass, NUTS-level) UNCERTAINTY-AWARE posterior inference of the per-patient residual-limb PRESSURE/FIT FIELD from SPARSE CHECK-SOCKET feedback, at CHAIRSIDE. Prosthetic-socket pressure-field prediction exists only as deterministic surrogates (FEA Kriging, real-time 1.6 ms) or point-estimate ANNs (strain->pressure inverse problem) with NO posterior; Bayesian UQ for soft tissue exists but is non-amortized (per-case MCMC/optimization) and not socket-specific; amortized probabilistic field inference exists but only for generic physical/flow fields. None combine amortized posterior + socket pressure field + sparse chairside feedback + uncertainty.
results.honest_adjacency: Three flanking bodies. (1) Socket pressure-FIELD prediction is mature but deterministic: FEA-driven Kriging surrogate (real-time 1.6 ms) and an ANN inverse-problem that infers interface pressure from socket-surface strain — same field, same speed goal, but point estimates, no uncertainty, not from check-socket feedback. (2) Bayesian UQ for hyperelastic soft tissue from sparse noisy data is exactly the inferential stance (posterior + uncertainty under data sparsity) but is non-amortized and not on sockets. (3) Amortized/probabilistic field reconstruction from sparse sensors (VAE, implicit nets, Cascaded Sensing with explicit UQ) is the precise AFIN-like method but applied to flow/physical fields. AFINs' specific slice — a single amortized network giving an uncertainty-aware socket pressure/fit posterior per patient at chairside from sparse check-socket data — falls in the unjoined center of (1)+(2)+(3).
results.reasoning: 5 reformulations (technique x app; app via ML/FEA; Bayesian UQ soft-tissue inverse problem; existing CAD/CAM & AI rectification tools; amortized field inference from sparse sensors). Each ingredient exists separately — socket pressure-field surrogates, soft-tissue Bayesian UQ, amortized probabilistic sparse-field inference, and AI socket rectification — but no work delivers amortized, uncertainty-aware, chairside socket-fit field posteriors from sparse check-socket feedback. Strong, honest adjacency on every axis with the exact intersection unmade, so NARROW (not CLOSED, since no posterior/amortized socket inference found; not OPEN, since the method and the field both exist independently).
